title: Ocean Glow Preset Pack
descriptionHtml:
Transform your underwater and coastal photography with rich tones, vivid color, and crisp contrast.

Dive into a world of color with the Ocean Glow Preset Pack, a collection of six professionally crafted Lightroom presets inspired by the serene beauty of tropical waters and the vibrant life beneath the waves. Perfect for beach lovers, divers, travelers, and content creators, these presets are designed to make your underwater, coastal, and travel images shine with clarity and depth — all with just a few clicks.

Whether you’re capturing the shimmer of sunlight on the sea floor, the vivid hues of coral reefs, Ocean Glow enhances the natural beauty of your images while preserving a true-to-life aesthetic.

What’s Included:
12 Signature Lightroom Presets
Designed for a variety of lighting and color conditions — from deep, cool blues to bright tropical tones.

Mobile and Desktop Compatibility
Works with the free Lightroom mobile app as well as Lightroom Classic and CC on desktop.

RAW and JPEG Support
Optimized for both professional RAW files and everyday JPEG images.

Easy Installation Instructions
Simple, step-by-step guide included so you can start editing in minutes.

These presets are ideal for:

-Snorkelers and scuba divers capturing underwater scenes

-Beachgoers and travelers seeking vibrant, polished photos

-Creators and influencers looking to maintain a cohesive, ocean-inspired aesthetic across their content

The Ocean Glow Preset Pack is more than just a time-saver — it’s a tool to help you tell your story through imagery that feels alive, vivid, and unforgettable.

title: Sun & Sand Preset Pack
descriptionHtml:
Discover the Salt & Sun preset pack — a thoughtfully curated collection of 7 Lightroom presets designed to elevate your outdoor, lifestyle, and travel photography. Inspired by golden hour light, earthy textures, and the natural beauty found on land, these presets add warmth, depth, and cohesion to every frame.

Whether you’re capturing rolling hills, sun-drenched beaches, lush forests, or candid moments in everyday life, salt & sun enhances your photos with true-to-life tones and effortless style — all in just a few clicks.

⸻

What’s Included:

7 signature Lightroom presets 

Perfect for various lighting conditions — from soft sunrise glow to bold mid-day sun and shadowed forest tones.

Mobile & Desktop Compatible
Works seamlessly with the free Lightroom mobile app and Lightroom Classic or CC on desktop.

RAW and JPEG Friendly
Ideal for both professional photography and casual phone snapshots.

Easy-to-Follow Installation Guide
Step-by-step instructions to get you editing within minutes.


These presets are perfect for:
    •    Outdoor photographers and nature lovers
    •    Lifestyle and portrait creators seeking earthy, cohesive edits
    •    Travel bloggers and influencers building a warm, adventurous aesthetic
